_comment: Round-265 bilingual fixture for digital.vasic.illm. Five locales — en, sr (Cyrillic), ja (Japanese), ar (Arabic, RTL), zh-CN (Han). Each entry carries a CoT problem statement + a few-shot examples block + a ToT design prompt in the target locale plus an ASCII pattern_id so the pattern/chain dispatch path is locale-agnostic. The runner uses these inputs to drive ChainOfThought + TreeOfThought + RenderPattern + RunChain end-to-end against a captured Runner that round-trips the rune payload back to the runner without any hardcoded translation table.
